name: Kallol Choudhury

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Kallol Choudhury works across poetry, short fiction and translation. Sahitya Akademi published Samparka, his Bengali translation of Jayanta Mahapatra’s Relationship, in 2006. His English poetry collection Buddha on Planchette was published by Penprints in 2023; his publisher also records contributions of stories, translations and a folktale to Oxford University Press anthologies.

The two poems gathered here turn affection into a landscape of colour and touch. “The Bluish Splendour Of Your Eyes” moves between brightness and passing gloom, finding transformation in an artistic hand. In “In The Moonlight Soaked Meadow,” afternoon, dusk and river become ways of remembering a face. The river’s movement carries the tenderness that the speaker tries to hold.
